title: Relationship Check-In Drift After Busy Weeks
dataSources: Relationship check-ins (`relationship:checkin`), date nights (`datenight:log`), gift ideas (`giftidea:item`), keep-in-touch contacts (`keptintouch:contact`).
app: Relationship and togetherness logs — shared check-in apps, date-night and gift-idea lists, and stay-in-touch reminders — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=relationship:checkin
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as checkins, avg(score) as avg_score by _time
| streamstats window=4 avg(checkins) as trailing_checkins
| eval low_contact=if(checkins<trailing_checkins*0.5,1,0)
| sort - _time
description: Flags weeks where relationship check-ins dropped sharply compared with your recent norm.
value: A sudden fall in check-ins is often the first sign that coordination and emotional maintenance are slipping.
implementation: Track check-ins in `index=personal`; compare each week with the trailing four-week baseline.
visualization: Weekly chart of check-in volume with anomaly highlighting.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks when the little check-ins that keep a relationship steady suddenly drop away during a busy stretch.
